# Changes made by Tarteel

These files began as a copy of selected files from Mihrab (https://github.com/MihrabHQ/Mihrab, Copyright (C) 2026 Hassan El Ghamri,
AGPL-3.0-or-later; see `UPSTREAM-LICENSES/`). Tarteel took them over on 2026-10-20 and now maintains them itself: there is no
automatic sync from Mihrab any more. The code stays under AGPL-3.0-or-later, and the upstream copyright and licence files stay in
`UPSTREAM-LICENSES/`.

AGPL-3.0 section 5(a) asks for a notice of what was modified, with a date. Every change to files/** is logged here, newest first.
`npm run upstream:status` lists the files that differ from the baseline (the state at takeover); CI fails if this file is missing.

Baseline: Mihrab commit recorded in `UPSTREAM.lock.json` (`detached.baselineSha`).

## Log
- 2026-10-20: taken over, no code changed yet.
